notes.title: Devlog #02: Forging the Hero’s Tools
notes.content:
[h3][b]Welcome back adventurers![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2893820/announcements/detail/532108091999651205?snr=2___"]first devlog[/url], we explored the [b]foundations of combat[/b] and how Tristan grows [b]from a humble cartographer into a capable fighter[/b]. But battles alone aren’t enough to survive the island. Every wound needs tending, every journey demands supplies, and every hero needs [b]tools [/b]worthy of the trials ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s where [b]crafting[/b] comes in: a system that turns raw materials into the weapons, armor, food, and potions that allow your journey to continue.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/qimBKek.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]When Tristan first sets foot on the island, he can roast meat over a fire, throw together a simple meal, but not much else. To thrive here, he’ll need to learn how to [b]forge[/b], [b]brew[/b], and [b]cook [/b]to [b]prepare[/b] for what the island throws at him.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]From Campfire to Master Forge[/b][/h2][p]Crafting begins small. A campfire meal, a sharpened blade, a healing potion. But as you find teachers, unlock recipes, and train your skills, the possibilities expand. [b]Whatever you craft [/b]will find its use at the right moment, sometimes [b]saving your life[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Food [/b]can go beyond restoring health and stamina: full meals provide [b]lasting bonuses[/b] to [b]strength[/b], [b]endurance[/b], or [b]resistance[/b], allowing you to be better prepared for dangerous adventures.[/p][p]
[b]Potions [/b]are not only [b]valuable out of combat, [/b]but also[b] in combat,[/b] since you can’t have a mid-battle snack. A quick draught of a [b]healing [/b]or [b]stamina [/b]potion can determine whether you live to strike back.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/Xcczrl0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Moreover, not every brew is used for recovery and defensive purposes: [b]poisons [/b]can be [b]applied to weapons[/b], giving your blade a temporary edge, whether it’s causing enemies to bleed faster, or weakening them with venom.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Gathering Materials[/b][/h2][p]Every recipe requires ingredients: after all, you can’t make an omelet without eggs. Some resources are [b]common[/b];  [b]herbs [/b]can be gathered in the wild, animals hunted for [b]meat[/b], [b]fish [/b]caught in rivers, or [b]eggs [/b]collected from chickens on farms. You can [b]mine ores[/b] or even [b]smelt scrap[/b] at the furnace into [b]ingots[/b], forming the basis for weapons.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/CO6DtKt.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Other resources may require more effort. Certain [b]rare plants [/b]or [b]monster-related ingredients[/b] lie hidden in dangerous regions, guarded by creatures that won’t give them up easily. Merchants, quests, and factions can also provide access to special resources, but none of them dictate your path: you can [b]decide whether to rely on trade, quest rewards, or gathering everything yourself.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Weapons, Armor, and the “Legend”[/b][/h2][p]Weapons forged by your own hand often come with lower stat requirements than those scavenged from the world. This means you can equip and use them earlier in your journey, giving you reliable options before rarer loot becomes available. But the true art lies with the [b]Master Blacksmith[/b] skill. Reaching it allows you to design a unique blade: [b]the[/b] [b]Legend[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/jyGr2xD.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This isn’t just another sword. It’s [b]customizable[/b], [b]upgradable[/b], and can absorb rare weapons found across the island. With enough dedication, it [b]may become one of the strongest weapons in the game[/b]… but never the only one. Many other rare arms rival it, each with unique properties, so [b]both crafters and adventurers have paths to power.[/b][/p][p]
[b]Armor[/b] follows a different path. Most sets can be discovered, but through [b]reinforcement[/b] you can fortify them beyond their base strength. At high levels, even ordinary armor can surpass expectations. Some pieces grant [b]specific bonuses[/b], while others focus on raw [b]defense.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Choice is Yours[/b][/h2][p]Crafting in [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b] is [b]simple in structure but deep in possibilities[/b]. The more you craft, the more perks and bonuses you unlock, from weapon sharpening to armor strengthening.[/p][p][/p][p]While merchants, quests, and factions all shape what you can access, none of them dictate your path. You might forge every tool yourself, or rely on loot and trade. You might become a [b]blacksmith [/b]known for blades, or an [b]alchemist [/b]living off potions. [b]The island allows both and rewards those who experiment.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]From the first cut of roasted meat to a legendary sword of your own design, [b]crafting is yet another way to make your story truly yours[/b]. It's more than just a set of bonuses: it’s the feeling of holding a weapon you forged yourself and personalizing it to your liking, brewing your potions so you don’t have to buy them at the market, or making your armor both strong and epic to look at.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for joining us for this second devlog! We’ll meet again soon![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Add Of Ash and Steel to your Wishlist[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel/"][/dynamiclink][/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FOfAshandSteel"]Twitter[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.reddit.com%2Fr%2FOfAshandSteel%2F"]Reddit[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F55putKmsDm"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbsky.app%2Fprofile%2Fofashandsteel.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@ofashandsteel"]TikTok[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New World Overview Trailer & Playtest Sign-Up
notes.content:
[i][b]Greetings, adventurers![/b][/i]

Our game was just featured at [b]tinyBuild Connect 2025[/b] with a [b]brand-new trailer[/b] showcasing the beautiful and dangerous world of Of Ash and Steel.

We invite you to hear from Tristan, a cartographer by trade and our hero by chance, as he guides you through the island of Grayshaft, its ecosystem, climate, and inhabitants (some more welcoming than others).

Starting today, you can also sign up for the upcoming closed playtest to experience the first few quests and the beginning of Tristan's journey. This is the first time we have let someone outside of the development team, our friends and family, and the publisher step foot onto Grayshaft! We will share more details on what to expect from this playtest in the coming days.

[h2][b]Head over to the Of Ash and Steel Steam page and click on the 'Request Access' button![/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel/

We will let the players into the playtest in waves, so please keep an eye out for your email notifications.

[h2][b]Check out the World Overview Trailer[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=MWe9CU1JFAc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Welcome to Grayshaft[/b][/h3]
Grayshaft is one of the islands of the Kingdom of the Seven. This island is beautiful, that much is certain: peaceful meadows stretch alongside endless crop fields, while small creeks wind their way through quiet hills and past sleepy villages. But thick, ancient forests soon take over the horizon, shrouding crumbling ruins and long-forgotten relics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/ca7678caf584a37f8fcffcbd83ca955bec525965.gif[/img]

Some folks describe the island as an entity, temperamental and unstable whenever it decides so. The weather turns on a whim, with a gentle breeze becoming a violent storm in moments. While some parts of the island bloom with color and life, others are locked in a frozen grip all year round. Even the ancient volcano at the heart of this area can’t warm up the lands it overlooks.

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdmI3bWVheW5semp3dmxobmZ5amZyYzF3eHdyb3Q5cm5rMjlxcWQxMCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/YebDqXI7ESw1GncES9/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Dangers in Every Step[/b][/h3]
Danger is never far behind. Whether wandering well-worn roads or exploring hidden paths, you’ll face bloodthirsty beasts, ruthless scavengers, and monstrous creatures. Heck, the bugs alone are the stuff of nightmares! Make one wrong move, and it could be your last.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/f6996dc52dffdbbff4c156ee9da96d7eb13bccd4.gif[/img]

But for those who press on, curiosity and courage are rewarded: hidden caves, buried treasures, and long-lost secrets await those brave enough to look where others didn’t dare to. Just look over your shoulder while exploring, or you might become another lost soul of the island.

[h3][b]Factions and Power Struggles[/b][/h3]
Wildlife, bandits and monsters are not the only dangerous entities on the island: Grayshaft is also home to factions, some of which are vying for control and power. The Order of the Seven stands tall with their code and discipline, while the Free Hunters answer to no one but their own sense of justice. Many more groups operate in the shadows or on the fringes of society, and you’ll never know who to trust at first glance. Rule of thumb: assume everything’s out to get you, and you’ll only be surprised when it’s not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/38035accfc02142a1b9296774f8055421bc8f3c7.gif[/img]

That’s all for today! 
We’re thrilled to begin unveiling the world of Of Ash and Steel to everyone, and this is just the beginning. Wishlist the game and stay tuned: more reveals and devlogs are coming soon.

[b]See you on the island![/b]

notes.title: Of Ash and Steel: The Development in Numbers
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, adventurers! We bring you news from the Island![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IFP399W.gif[/img]

We’re incredibly grateful for all the support you've shown over the past few months for us and [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b]. Since our last devlog, we've been working tirelessly behind the scenes, and that effort is finally bearing fruit. For a young studio like ours, this journey has been nothing short of thrilling and truly epic.
Today, we're excited to share what we’ve accomplished and brought to life:

[list]
[*] 300+ quests
[*] 30,000+ lines of dialogue
[*] 270+ pieces of armor, clothing, rings, and amulets
[*] 180+ weapons
[*] 30+ monsters
[*] 200+ crafting recipes
[*] 3 unique pets
[*] 5+ hours of original in-game music
[*] 50+ buried treasures
[*] 80+ random world events
[*] And much more!
[/list]
We are still testing, optimizing, and polishing so that, at launch, we can offer you the best experience. This phase is every bit as important as core development, but now that we can see the end of the road, every breath feels a little lighter!

And there’s even more ahead! We’ll be ramping up promotional activities in the coming weeks to spread the word about [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b] to as many adventurers as possible. At the same time, we’ll start sharing more cool things that we have under wraps, including story details and new game mechanics.

[h3][b]Wishlist the game and follow us for more news: [/b][/h3]

notes.title: Introducing Of Ash and Steel
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers! Come sit closer to the fire—we have a story to tell. 

We’re thrilled to announce Of [b]Ash and Steel[/b], an immersive third-person open-world RPG created by a passionate team that values the essence of classic old-school RPGs and modern designs. Step into the Kingdom of the Seven, a realm brimming with secrets, danger, and opportunities for the bold to shape their own fate.

[h2] [b]Watch the announcement trailer[/b] [/h2]
[previewyoutube=JYB0piWxULE;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s a first look at what awaits you:

[h2] [b]Master the Art of Combat[/b] [/h2]
You are not a Legendary Hero by default in Of Ash and Steel. Every battle improves your skills. Choose from multiple combat stances and fighting styles, adapting your approach with each encounter. No honor or fighting fairly, because your enemies will do the same!

[h2] [b]Shape the Fate of the World[/b] [/h2]
Your choices matter. Become stronger, forge alliances, and make your mark on a world that reacts to your decisions. From outcast to legend, your journey will leave its mark in one way or another.

[h2] [b]Explore Like You Used To[/b] [/h2]
Rediscover the joy of exploration in a world without quest markers or guides. Every path and hidden treasure is yours to uncover, with a living atmosphere rich in dynamic weather, daily NPC routines, and the sounds of a world that draws you in at every step.


In [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b], we invite you to experience a game inspired by classic RPGs, with no hand-holding, just the thrill of discovery, challenge, and mastery. Are you ready to start your journey? Sharpen your blade and steady your resolve — the Kingdom of the Seven awaits. Your path to glory begins here. Add Of Ash and Steel to your [b]wishlist [/b]today, and join us on this journey!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel 

This is just scratching the surface of what’s possible in the world Of Ash and Steel. We’ll be sharing more details about the game in the coming months, so keep your eyes peeled.

Join our Discord to share a pint and your stories with other adventurers and the devs: https://discord.gg/QDZNNxZmE4

Follow Of Ash and Steel on X for the latest news and updates: https://x.com/OfAshandSteel
